simple.meaning: עֶשְׂרִים (ʻesrîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “twenty ; also (ordinal) twentieth.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 315 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 6:3. Its contexts include family, flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֶשְׂרִים (H6242).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
